libraries.name: wins-kernel32
libraries.summary: Files, memory, threads and synchronisation (real threads, lock-free critical sections), time, ini files, console. Many of the ~900 kernel32 exports are not implemented.
libraries.evidence: FalloutNV.exe (Steam build, i386) played through the menu, New Game and the Mojave exterior; the library appears in that run's loader log (WINS 8c50dda, 2026-11-15)

libraries.name: wins-ntdll
libraries.summary: A handful of Nt*/Rtl* calls used by anti-debug and loader code.

libraries.name: wins-psapi
libraries.summary: Process and module enumeration.

libraries.name: wins-version
libraries.summary: File version resources (GetFileVersionInfo, VerQueryValue).

libraries.name: wins-dbghelp
libraries.summary: Stack walking entry points, answered without symbols.

libraries.name: wins-msvcrt
libraries.summary: The C runtime a program imports instead of linking statically.

libraries.name: wins-user32
libraries.summary: Window classes, windows, message queues, activation and input messages over a host X11 window. i386 uses wins_user32.zig; the x86-64 GUI loader uses winrun_gui_support.zig.
libraries.evidence: FalloutNV.exe (Steam build, i386) played through the menu, New Game and the Mojave exterior; the library appears in that run's loader log (WINS 8c50dda, 2026-11-15)

libraries.name: wins-gdi32
libraries.summary: i386: GetStockObject only. x86-64 GUI loader: a larger drawing surface.

libraries.name: wins-winmm
libraries.summary: timeGetTime and mmio* (RIFF files read through the caller's own I/O procedure, with the I/O buffer). No waveOut/midi on i386.
libraries.evidence: FalloutNV.exe (Steam build, i386) played through the menu, New Game and the Mojave exterior; the library appears in that run's loader log (WINS 8c50dda, 2026-11-15)

libraries.name: wins-xinput
libraries.summary: XInput 1.3/1.4/9.1.0 over host SDL2 GameController (via dlopen, with GetStateEx ordinal 100, vibration, capabilities, audio/battery queries); returns not connected when no gamepad or libSDL2 is present.

libraries.name: wins-d3d9
libraries.summary: Direct3D 9 on the host GPU through OpenGL: devices, Reset (pool/backbuffer validation and host resize), 2D/cube/volume textures, UpdateSurface and UpdateTexture, render targets, state blocks (Create/Begin/End/Capture/Apply), shader-model 3 translated to GLSL, fixed-function transform and vertex lighting (directional/point/spot, materials, ambient), clip planes, occlusion queries. Renders on the NVIDIA GPU when present.
libraries.evidence: FalloutNV.exe (Steam build, i386) played through the menu, New Game and the Mojave exterior; the library appears in that run's loader log (WINS 8c50dda, 2026-11-15)

libraries.name: wins-d3dx9
libraries.summary: Matrix/vector math, shader and DDS 2D/cube/volume texture helpers; only the exports a measured program needed.

libraries.name: wins-dsound
libraries.summary: DirectSound 8: buffers, DuplicateSoundBuffer, IDirectSoundNotify position notifications, a software mixer with 3D positioning to PipeWire/PulseAudio. No EAX, no capture.
libraries.evidence: FalloutNV.exe (Steam build, i386) played through the menu, New Game and the Mojave exterior; the library appears in that run's loader log (WINS 8c50dda, 2026-11-15)

libraries.name: wins-dinput8
libraries.summary: DirectInput 8 keyboard and mouse fed by the host window, plus gamepads/joysticks backed by XInput/SDL2. No force feedback or action mapping.
libraries.evidence: FalloutNV.exe (Steam build, i386) played through the menu, New Game and the Mojave exterior; the library appears in that run's loader log (WINS 8c50dda, 2026-11-15)

libraries.name: wins-quartz
libraries.summary: DirectShow filter graph for pull-mode MPEG audio, reached through ole32!CoCreateInstance (CLSID_FilterGraph), not imported by name. No video renderer.
libraries.evidence: FalloutNV.exe (Steam build, i386) played through the menu, New Game and the Mojave exterior; the library appears in that run's loader log (WINS 8c50dda, 2026-11-15)

libraries.name: wins-binkw32
libraries.summary: Bink video and audio decoding through the host i386 libavcodec (binkvideo, binkaudio_dct/binkaudio_rdft) and wins_audio.zig; nine exports.
libraries.evidence: FalloutNV.exe played FNVIntro.bik through this library in a run on 2026-11-14 (WINS ea7773f); no live Bink audio run recorded

libraries.name: wins-vorbisfile
libraries.summary: A bridge to the host's real i386 libvorbisfile (needs libvorbisfile3:i386), not a decoder written here.
libraries.evidence: FalloutNV.exe (Steam build, i386) played through the menu, New Game and the Mojave exterior; the library appears in that run's loader log (WINS 8c50dda, 2026-11-15)

libraries.name: wins-steam-api
libraries.summary: A bridge to the real running Steam client (ISteamClient, ISteamUser, ISteamUtils, ISteamAppTicket, ISteamUserStats007, ISteamApps003, ISteamFriends005 answered by it). Needs Steam running.
libraries.evidence: FalloutNV.exe (Steam build, i386) played through the menu, New Game and the Mojave exterior; the library appears in that run's loader log (WINS 8c50dda, 2026-11-15)

libraries.name: wins-advapi32
libraries.summary: Registry (in-memory), crypto random, tokens. Not persistent.
libraries.evidence: FalloutNV.exe (Steam build, i386) played through the menu, New Game and the Mojave exterior; the library appears in that run's loader log (WINS 8c50dda, 2026-11-15)

libraries.name: wins-ole32
libraries.summary: COM initialisation and CoCreateInstance for the classes WINS implements (DirectShow filter graph).
libraries.evidence: FalloutNV.exe (Steam build, i386) played through the menu, New Game and the Mojave exterior; the library appears in that run's loader log (WINS 8c50dda, 2026-11-15)

libraries.name: wins-oleaut32
libraries.summary: BSTR and variant helpers.

libraries.name: wins-shell32
libraries.summary: Known folders mapped to the WINS profile, ShellExecute, CommandLineToArgv.

libraries.name: wins-shlwapi
libraries.summary: Path and string helpers.

libraries.name: wins-comctl32
libraries.summary: InitCommonControls; no common-control windows.

libraries.name: wins-ws2-32
libraries.summary: Winsock entry points.

libraries.name: wins-crypto
libraries.summary: Crypto API entry points; certificate and key stores are not real.

libraries.name: wins-ldap
libraries.summary: LDAP entry points.

libraries.name: wins-netmisc
libraries.summary: Network and trust helpers; a few entry points each.

libraries.name: wins-directx-x64
libraries.summary: x86-64 loader only: Direct3D 11 / DXGI / HLSL compiler shims. Not a rendering implementation.
